items.title: Colimits of sets and maps out of a finite set
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the comparison map of an inductive system of sets is a bijection when tested against a finite set (statement lines 325-329). The proof is a complete argument: surjectivity follows because the finitely many values of a map into the colimit are represented in a single stage by directedness (proof lines 331-339); injectivity follows because two maps agreeing in the colimit agree at each of the finitely many elements after passing to a later stage, and the finitely many stages can be combined into one (proof lines 340-345). The non-formal content is the finite bookkeeping with directedness. The claim is H2.
